news.title: Arvex To Replace Kim Hin Joo On Bursa ACE Market From Sept 11

recent_en: ARVEX recently completed a board reshuffle with several director changes, alongside disclosures of changes in director and substantial shareholder interests. The company will replace Kim Hin Joo on Bursa ACE Market from 11 September 2026. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 have been announced.
notable_en: The company will replace Kim Hin Joo on Bursa ACE Market from 11 September 2026.
On 28 August 2026, multiple board changes were announced, including MR PANG KIM HIN, MISS KOR YANN NING, MR CHEW SOO LIN, and MR HEW MOH YUNG.
On 6 October 2026, another board change was announced for MR YAP SHUH JIAN.
risks_en: On 29 September 2026, changes in interests were disclosed for Director MR PANG KIM HIN and substantial shareholders MR PANG KIM HIN and KIM HIN INTERNATIONAL PTE. LTD.
